# Best Denver Accountant

> Denver accounting information for small businesses and residents: bookkeeping, business and personal tax preparation, payroll (including Denver's occupational privilege tax) and fractional CFO services.

## Denver facts (City and County of Denver)
- Occupational privilege tax: $5.75/month employee share (at $500+/month from one employer); $4.00/month business share per taxable employee and per owner, partner or manager.
- City sales tax 5.15%; combined general sales/use rate 9.15%; lodger's tax 10.75%.
- Statewide companion resource: https://www.bestcpacolorado.com/
